an10.24:1.1: On one occasion the Venerable Mahācunda was dwelling among the Cetis at Sahajāti.
an10.24:1.2: There the Venerable Mahācunda addressed the bhikkhus:
an10.24:2.1: “Friends, making a declaration of knowledge, a bhikkhu says:
an10.24:2.2: ‘I know this Dhamma, I see this Dhamma.’
an10.24:2.3: If, however, greed overcomes that bhikkhu and persists;
an10.24:2.12: evil desire overcomes that bhikkhu and persists, he should be understood thus:
an10.24:2.13: ‘This venerable one does not understand in such a way that he would have no greed; thus greed overcomes him and persists.
an10.24:2.14: This venerable one does not understand in such a way that he would have no hatred …
an10.24:2.22: no evil desire; thus evil desire overcomes him and persists.’
an10.24:3.1: “Friends, making a declaration of development, a bhikkhu says:
an10.24:3.2: ‘I am developed in body, virtuous behavior, mind, and wisdom.’
an10.24:3.3: If, however, greed overcomes that bhikkhu and persists;
an10.24:3.12: evil desire overcomes that bhikkhu and persists, he should be understood thus:
an10.24:3.13: ‘This venerable one does not understand in such a way that he would have no greed; thus greed overcomes him and persists.
an10.24:3.14: This venerable one does not understand in such a way that he would have no hatred …
an10.24:3.22: no evil desire; thus evil desire overcomes him and persists.’
an10.24:4.1: “Friends, making a declaration of knowledge and development, a bhikkhu says:
an10.24:4.2: ‘I know this Dhamma, I see this Dhamma. I am developed in body, virtuous behavior, mind, and wisdom.’
an10.24:4.3: If, however, greed overcomes that bhikkhu and persists;
an10.24:4.12: evil desire overcomes that bhikkhu and persists, he should be understood thus:
an10.24:4.13: ‘This venerable one does not understand in such a way that he would have no greed; thus greed overcomes him and persists.
an10.24:4.14: This venerable one does not understand in such a way that he would have no hatred …
an10.24:4.22: no evil desire; thus evil desire overcomes him and persists.’
an10.24:5.1: “Suppose a poor, destitute, and needy person claims to be rich, affluent, and wealthy.
an10.24:5.2: If, when he wants to buy something, he cannot pay with money, grain, silver, or gold,
an10.24:5.4: a poor, destitute, and needy person claiming to be rich, affluent, and wealthy.
an10.24:5.6: Because when he wants to buy something, he cannot pay with money, grain, silver, or gold.
an10.24:6.1: “So too, friends, making a declaration of knowledge and development, a bhikkhu says:
an10.24:6.2: ‘I know this Dhamma, I see this Dhamma. I am developed in body, virtuous behavior, mind, and wisdom.’
an10.24:6.3: If, however, greed overcomes that bhikkhu and persists …
an10.24:6.12: evil desire overcomes that bhikkhu and persists, he should be understood thus:
an10.24:6.13: ‘This venerable one does not understand in such a way that he would have no greed; thus greed overcomes him and persists.
an10.24:6.14: This venerable one does not understand in such a way that he would have no hatred …
an10.24:6.22: no evil desire; thus evil desire overcomes him and persists.’
an10.24:7.1: “Friends, making a declaration of knowledge, a bhikkhu says:
an10.24:7.2: ‘I know this Dhamma, I see this Dhamma.’
an10.24:7.3: If greed does not overcome that bhikkhu and persist;
an10.24:7.12: evil desire does not overcome that bhikkhu and persist, he should be understood thus:
an10.24:7.13: ‘This venerable one understands in such a way that he has no greed; thus greed does not overcome him and persist.
an10.24:7.14: This venerable one understands in such a way that he has no hatred …
an10.24:7.22: no evil desire; thus evil desire does not overcome him and persist.’
an10.24:8.1: “Friends, making a declaration of development, a bhikkhu says:
an10.24:8.2: ‘I am developed in body, virtuous behavior, mind, and wisdom.’
an10.24:8.3: If greed does not overcome that bhikkhu and persist;
an10.24:8.12: evil desire does not overcome that bhikkhu and persist, he should be understood thus:
an10.24:8.13: ‘This venerable one understands in such a way that he has no greed; thus greed does not overcome him and persist.
an10.24:8.14: This venerable one understands in such a way that he has no hatred …
an10.24:8.22: no evil desire; thus evil desire does not overcome him and persist.’
an10.24:9.1: “Friends, making a declaration of knowledge and development, a bhikkhu says:
an10.24:9.2: ‘I know this Dhamma, I see this Dhamma. I am developed in body, virtuous behavior, mind, and wisdom.’
an10.24:9.3: If greed does not overcome that bhikkhu and persist;
an10.24:9.12: evil desire does not overcome that bhikkhu and persist, he should be understood thus:
an10.24:9.13: ‘This venerable one understands in such a way that he has no greed; thus greed does not overcome him and persist.
an10.24:9.14: This venerable one understands in such a way that he has no hatred …
an10.24:9.22: no evil desire; thus evil desire does not overcome him and persist.’
an10.24:10.1: “Suppose a rich, affluent, and wealthy person claims to be rich, affluent, and wealthy.
an10.24:10.2: If, when he wants to buy something, he can pay with money, grain, silver, or gold,
an10.24:10.4: a rich, affluent, and wealthy person who claims to be rich, affluent, and wealthy.
an10.24:10.6: Because when he wants to buy something, he can pay with money, grain, silver, or gold.
an10.24:11.1: “So too, friends, making a declaration of knowledge and development, a bhikkhu says:
an10.24:11.2: ‘I know this Dhamma, I see this Dhamma. I am developed in body, virtuous behavior, mind, and wisdom.’
an10.24:11.3: If greed does not overcome that bhikkhu and persist;
an10.24:11.12: evil desire does not overcome that bhikkhu and persist, he should be understood thus:
an10.24:11.13: ‘This venerable one understands in such a way that he has no greed; thus greed does not overcome him and persist.
an10.24:11.14: This venerable one understands in such a way that he has no hatred …
an10.24:11.22: no evil desire; thus evil desire does not overcome him and persist.’”
